  • Company Secretary (CS)

    Indian Courses

    3 years

    The Company Secretary (CS) course is one of the most prestigious professional qualifications in India, designed for individuals who aspire to build a career in corporate law, compliance, governance, and strategic management. Conducted by the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), the CS program prepares professionals to take up key managerial and advisory roles in companies across sectors actively involved in corporate decision-making processes, including negotiations, regulatory coordination, mergers and acquisitions, and dispute resolution.

    View Course

  • ACCA Course - Duration, Eligibility and Exemptions

    4.8

    Global Pathways

    2-3 Years

    3 Levels

    ACCA stands for Association of Chartered Certified Accountants. It is a UK based accounting body, founded in 1904. It is one of the most widely accepted accounting qualification with over 250,000 members and 600,000 students in 180 countries. ACCA is headquartered in London, and works through a network of over 100 offices and centers in 52 countries with more than 7,000 Approved Employers worldwide.

    View Course

  • Cost and Management Accountant (CMA India)

    4.9

    Indian Courses

    3.5 years

    3 Levels

    CMA is Cost & Management Accountants Professional Course of India. It is popularly known as ICWA Course. This course is offered by the Institute of Cost & Management Accountants of India (ICMAI) set up by an act of Parliament. CMAs are handling posts such as Business Analyst, Finance Reporting, Cost Controller, Internal Auditor and Tax Consultant etc. They help businesses to grow by their ability to handle resources wisely and help management in strategic decision making. CMA Institute started in 1944, it has been around 82 years since then.

    View Course

  • CFA Course - Build Your Career in Investment Banking & Finance

    4.8

    Global Pathways

    3 years

    3 Levels

    The CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) program is globally recognised as the gold standard certification for careers in investment banking, equity research, portfolio management, asset management, wealth management, and corporate finance. Administered by the CFA Institute (USA), the CFA qualification provides in-depth expertise in financial reporting and analysis, quantitative methods, fixed income, derivatives, alternative investments, risk management, and strategic portfolio planning. With increasing demand for skilled investment professionals in global capital markets, CFA charterholders are highly preferred by top financial institutions, multinational banks, private equity firms, hedge funds, and investment advisory companies. The CFA program equips candidates with advanced analytical capabilities and real-world financial decision-making skills, making it one of the most respected and high-paying qualifications in the global finance industry.

    View Course

  • CMA USA Course - Details & Career Opportunities

    4.9

    Global Pathways

    9-12 months

    2 Levels

    The US CMA (Certified Management Accountant) is one of the most in-demand global certifications in management accounting, corporate finance, financial planning, and strategic business management. Offered by the Institute of Management Accountants (IMA), USA, the US CMA credential is internationally recognised and highly preferred by multinational corporations (MNCs), global shared service centres, consulting firms, and Fortune 500 companies. With increasing demand for strategic finance professionals in global markets, US CMA offers strong career growth, international recognition, and competitive salary opportunities in the corporate finance domain.

    View Course

  • 11th - 12th Commerce

    4.8

    Career Arena

    2 years

    2 Levels

    The 11th and 12th Commerce program is the foundational stage of specialised commerce education at the higher secondary level. It introduces students to core business, finance, and economic concepts while building academic discipline and structured learning habits. With a balanced focus on theory, numerical application, and board-oriented preparation, these two years help students develop subject depth, clarity of direction, and readiness for higher studies and professional pathways in commerce.

    View Course

  • Chartered Global Management Accountant (CGMA - CIMA UK)

    4.9

    Global Pathways

    1 to 2 years

    3 Levels

    The CGMA Professional Qualification, offered by CIMA (UK), is a globally recognised program that develops future-ready finance and business leaders. The qualification combines accounting, finance, strategy, risk management, and business leadership to equip students with the skills required in today's dynamic corporate environment. With a practical and industry-focused curriculum, CGMA prepares professionals to drive business performance and strategic decision-making across organisations worldwide.

    View Course

  • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)

    4.8

    Global Pathways

    12-18 months

    4 Levels

    CIA stands for Certified Internal Auditor. It is the only globally recognized certification for internal auditors, awarded by the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA), a US-based professional body founded in 1941 and headquartered in Lake Mary, Florida. The IIA has over 265,000 members across 170 countries and territories, and sets the Global Internal Audit Standards that govern the profession worldwide. The CIA is earned by clearing a three-part exam covering the fundamentals, practice, and business knowledge of internal auditing.

    View Course

  • US CPA Course - Your Path to a Global Accounting Career

    4.9

    Global Pathways

    1-2 years

    4 Levels

    The US Certified Public Accountant (US CPA) is one of the world's most prestigious accounting qualification, issued by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) - the largest accounting body globally. The US CPA credential is recognised in 130+ countries and is the gateway to high-impact careers in accounting, audit, taxation, financial advisory, and senior finance leadership at Big 4 firms, MNCs, and US-based organisations worldwide. JK Shah Classes brings its decades of expert faculty-driven coaching to the US CPA programme - combining structured live teaching with UWorld's industry-leading exam preparation platform to deliver one of India's most comprehensive CPA coaching programmes.

    View Course

  • Certified Financial Planner (CFP)

    4.8

    Global Pathways

    12 to 18 months

    2 Levels

    The CFP® (Certified Financial Planner) certification is one of the most respected professional qualifications in financial planning and wealth management. Awarded by the Financial Planning Standards Board (FPSB) India, a wholly owned subsidiary of Financial Planning Standards Board (FPSB), the certification equips candidate with the knowledge and skills required to provide comprehensive financial advice across investments, retirement planning, taxation, insurance, estate planning, and personal finance. The program combines technical expertise with practical financial planning capabilities, preparing candidates to help individuals and families make informed financial decisions and achieve long-term financial goals.

    View Course

  • Enrolled Agent (EA)

    4.9

    Global Pathways

    7 to 12 months

    3 Levels

    The Enrolled Agent (EA) credential is the highest qualification awarded by the IRS, recognizing individuals who are experts in federal taxation and authorized to represent taxpayers before the IRS. Our comprehensive EA preparation course is meticulously designed to equip you with the in-depth knowledge and practical skills required to pass all three parts of the Special Enrollment Examination (SEE) and become a distinguished Enrolled Agent. This program is ideal for accounting and finance professionals seeking to advance their careers, expand their expertise in US tax laws, and offer invaluable tax advisory services.

    View Course

Frequently Asked Questions

What professional courses does JK Shah Classes offer?

JK Shah Classes offers expert coaching and courses for CA (Chartered Accountant), ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants), CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), US CMA (Certified Management Accountant), US CPA (Certified Public Accountant), CS (Company Secretary), and CMA India. Both online and offline learning options are available for all major courses.

How many years has JK Shah Classes been operating?

JK Shah Classes has been operating since 1983, with over 43 years of continuous excellence in professional accounting and finance education. The institute is one of the oldest and most established coaching institutes in India.

How many students has JK Shah Classes trained?

JK Shah Classes has trained over 5,15,987 students across India and online as of the latest count. The institute has also produced 3,885+ All India Rankers since 2001.

Does JK Shah Classes offer online classes?

Yes. JK Shah Classes offers live online classes, recorded lecture libraries, and hybrid learning options for CA, ACCA, CFA, US CMA, US CPA, and other courses. Online students receive access to the same study material, mock tests, and faculty support as classroom students.

How many centres does JK Shah Classes have?

JK Shah Classes has 116 face-to-face centres across 41 cities and 10 states in India. Major cities include Mumbai, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad, Pune, and many others. A full online platform is also available for students outside these locations.

Which is the right course for me - CA, ACCA, CFA, US CMA, or US CPA?

The right course depends on career goals. CA is ideal for Indian domestic careers in audit, tax, and finance. ACCA is best for international accounting careers. CFA is the choice for investment banking and portfolio management. US CMA suits management accounting and FP&A roles at MNCs. US CPA is the gateway to US accounting and Big 4 international roles. JK Shah Classes offers free admissions counselling to help students choose the right path.

Does JK Shah Classes offer placement assistance?

Yes. JK Shah Classes provides placement assistance for students who complete professional courses. Alumni work at firms including J.P. Morgan, KPMG, Accenture, Citibank, HDFC Securities, Kotak, and Tata Group.

What makes JK Shah Classes different from other coaching institutes?

JK Shah Classes differentiates through four decades of consistent results, specialist faculty for every course and level, a structured study methodology that is tested and proven, and a pan-India presence of 116 centres alongside a full online platform. The combination of legacy, scale, and academic rigour has made it the first choice for over 5 lakh students.

Can working professionals join courses at JK Shah Classes?

Yes. JK Shah Classes offers flexible learning options specifically for working professionals, including weekend batches, early morning sessions, live online classes, and recorded lecture libraries. Courses like US CMA, US CPA, ACCA, and CFA are particularly popular among finance professionals looking to add a global credential to their profile.

How do I enrol at JK Shah Classes?

Students can enrol by visiting any of the 116 JK Shah Classes centres across India or by contacting the admissions team at +91 9757111333 or info@jkshahclasses.com. Online course enrolment is also available through the website.
